text: Took two scoops of pre, my face is tingling, I think I'm dying!
You're probably fine. Here's what's inside that scoop.
Most of the effect comes from one ingredient: caffeine. It boosts energy, focus, and performance.
The tingling is beta-alanine. It's harmless, and may help with higher-rep sets. Citrulline gives you the pump.
Check the caffeine per scoop, never double scoop, and skip it within six hours of bed.
Verdict: optional. A strong coffee does most of the job. Save this.
